environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. Outbound traffic routes through a VPC endpoint policy-controlled interface. The S3 VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f) has a resource policy with Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID match AND s3:prefix to start with 'audit-logs/'. Additionally, the subnet's route table has NO internet gateway or NAT gateway route — all traffic must traverse VPC endpoints. The only other VPC endpoint provisioned is for ECR (to pull container images). There is NO VPC endpoint for SES/SMTP, and the security group attached to the ENI restricts egress to port 443 only with destination prefix list pl-63a5400a (S3) and the ECR endpoint CIDR. SMTP port 587/25 egress is not permitted by security group rules, and no NAT/IGW path exists for the SMTP connection to succeed.

config.runtime: Go 1.21 on ECS Fargate 1.4.0, private subnet
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway, route table has only local + vpce routes
config.security_group_egress: Allow TCP/443 to pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) and 10.0.1.0/24 (ECR endpoint ENI CIDR) only
config.smtp_connectivity: No VPC endpoint for SES SMTP; no NAT/IGW; security group blocks port 587/25 egress
